comment: A design for tools/ui-scripts/parameter-unknown-name.mitcad-ui (mitcad#1723): Sketch1 on XY holds a 40 x 25 rectangle (its width k5 d1, its height k6 d2), a free line from (0, 40) to (30, 40) for a new dimension and a construction line at x = -30 that widens the fitted view to the dimensions' values; Extrude1 (F2) extrudes the rectangle 10 mm (d3). No user parameters.
